# The New Physician - Secret Box

Anonymous, secure secret sharing and curated human insights engine.

## Core Navigation Map
- Main App: https://secretbox.hive.baby
- Daily Secret Drops: https://secretbox.hive.baby/daily
- Monthly Art Gallery: https://secretbox.hive.baby/art/current
- Admin Portal: https://secretbox.hive.baby/admin

## Entity Table
- Name: Secret Box
- Main Utility: Anonymous messaging, encryption keys, and collective human resonance maps.
- Tech Stack: Next.js, Cloudflare Pages, Neon PostgreSQL, Stripe payments.
- Database Driver: Serverless PostgreSQL client (`@neondatabase/serverless`).
